Limitless.name: Unlimited Void
Limitless.sureHit: All technique attacks become sure-hit and freeze enemy reaction.
Limitless.description: An endless void of boundless information. The enemy is paralyzed by infinite data.

Blood Manipulation.name: Crimson Blood Palace
Blood Manipulation.sureHit: Blood attacks become sure-hit and crystallize the enemy's cursed energy.
Blood Manipulation.description: A Palace of coagulated blood. Every drop answers to you.

Ten Shadows Technique.name: Chimera Shadow Garden
Ten Shadows Technique.sureHit: Every conquered shikigami attacks simultaneously as sure-hit ambushes.
Ten Shadows Technique.description: A living garden of shadow where all your shikigami hunt as one.

Ratio.name: Idle Death Gamble
Ratio.sureHit: Strikes always land on the perfect 7:3 ratio weak point.
Ratio.description: The gamble of fate. The odds always favor you.

Projection Sorcery.name: Time Cell Moon Palace
Projection Sorcery.sureHit: Movement becomes 24fps-perfect; every frame strikes as a sure hit.
Projection Sorcery.description: A palace where time itself moves at your frame rate.

Boogie Woogie.name: Endless Exchange Hall
Boogie Woogie.sureHit: Unlimited clap-swaps let every strike land from impossible angles.
Boogie Woogie.description: A hall of infinite claps. Position is an illusion.

Chimera Shadow Garden.name: Garden of the Black Divine
Chimera Shadow Garden.sureHit: Shadow tendrils erupt from every surface as sure hits.
Chimera Shadow Garden.description: A garden where shadow is the only law.

Disaster Curse.name: Calamity Temple
Disaster Curse.sureHit: Natural disaster strikes become inevitable and sure-hit.
Disaster Curse.description: A temple where catastrophe is eternal.

Awakening.name: Origin of Creation
Awakening.sureHit: Your awakened strike manifests as a sure-hit conceptual blow.
Awakening.description: The source from which all technique flows.
